chars.S: SOFIANE: a young man wearing a wrinkled mustard-yellow hoodie, dark blue jeans, white sneakers, metal handcuffs on his wrists.
chars.P: POLICEMAN: a Moroccan policeman wearing a navy-blue police uniform with a peaked navy cap, silver badge and white shoulder cords.
chars.J: JUDGE: an older Moroccan judge wearing a black judicial robe with a green collar band, small round glasses.
chars.M: MOTHER: a Moroccan mother wearing a beige djellaba and a white headscarf.
chars.F: FATHER: a Moroccan father wearing a brown djellaba and a red fez hat.

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: In a Moroccan courthouse hallway with wooden benches, the POLICEMAN leans close to SOFIANE's ear and secretly whispers, covering his mouth with one hand and glancing sideways so nobody sees; SOFIANE in handcuffs looks tense and surprised.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Close medium shot in the courthouse hallway: the POLICEMAN stares seriously at SOFIANE and raises one finger as a warning while speaking quietly; SOFIANE listens, eyes wide.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The POLICEMAN shows SOFIANE five fingers with a grim face, warning him about years in prison; SOFIANE goes pale with fear, a barred window behind them in the courthouse.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The POLICEMAN walks away down the courthouse corridor glancing back once, while SOFIANE stays on the wooden bench in handcuffs, thinking hard, worried.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: SOFIANE sits frozen on the wooden bench in the courthouse corridor, hands in handcuffs on his knees, shocked expression, a dramatic cold light falling on him.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: SOFIANE holds his head with both cuffed hands in panic in the courthouse corridor; behind him a dark prison cell with iron bars appears like a fearful vision in the shadows.

scenes.name: n7.png
scenes.scene: A Moroccan courtroom with wooden benches and a high judge's desk and a Moroccan flag; the POLICEMAN escorts SOFIANE in handcuffs through the door into the courtroom.

scenes.name: n8.png
scenes.scene: In the courtroom, the MOTHER and FATHER sit on a wooden bench looking at SOFIANE with deep sadness and regret; the MOTHER presses a hand on her chest, the FATHER looks down; SOFIANE looks back at them ashamed.

scenes.name: n9.png
scenes.scene: SOFIANE stands alone in handcuffs before the high wooden judge's desk; the JUDGE sits behind it looking down at him coldly, holding a pen above a file; a Moroccan flag beside the desk.
